mapper.select: SELECT id, voice_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, deleted FROM tb_voice_attachment WHERE voice_id = #{voiceId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC
SELECT id, voice_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, deleted FROM tb_voice_attachment WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_voice_attachment ( voice_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{voiceId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{uploadedBy}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_voice_attachment SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
